title: Freeness of Pluricanonical Linear System on Smooth Minimal n-folds of General Type
summary: Let $X$ be a smooth minimal projective variety of general type of dimension $n\geq 4$ over $\bb C$. We prove that $|\frac{n^2+n}{2}K_X|$ is base point free. This gives a new bound for the pluricanonical case of Fujita Freeness Conjecture for nef and big canonical divisors.
